newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Just Jeans, C. Road dip on warning.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Just Jeans, C. Road dip on warning.

text.p: Shares in clothing retailers Country Road Ltd and Just Jeans Holdings Ltd dipped at the opening on Wednesday following profit warnings issued by the companies after the close of trading on Tuesday.
At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT) Country Road shares were 18 cents lower at A$1.50. Just Jeans shares were down three at A$1.77.
However, volumes in the thinly traded stocks were light.

On Tuesday, Country Road said trading profit for the 1996/97 first half could be more than 50 percent lower than the previous corresponding period. Just Jeans said it expected first half pre-tax profit to be 50 percent lower than a year earlier.
